propositions: The transition library signature must be normalized from split force(bool) + reason(str) + force_close(str) to a single force(str|None) parameter matching claim's shape, where the string value carries the audit reason and None means not forcing.

The transition CLI must drop --reason as a fallback for the force-bypass audit note; --force[=<reason>] becomes the sole approved pattern (bare --force → '(no reason given)'), byte-identical to claim.
Legacy callers passing transition(force_close=) or transition(force=True) must warn via rebar._deprecations and map to the new force string parameter to maintain backward compatibility.

The in-memory concept 'force-bypass reason' must be spelled force_reason uniformly across transition and claim internals, while the persisted status_data['force_close_reason'] key is retained unchanged (historical event schema compatibility).
All transition/claim guidance strings (CLI help, gates override hints, txn plumbing messages) must show only the --force[=<reason>] pattern with no decoupled --reason-as-force-note wording.
The force bypass must apply identically to both start-work and completion-verify close gates for transition, keying on force presence (is not None) rather than on separate force_close state.
